skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and evaluate the logical structure of concepts, judgments, and reasoning.
Apply logical principles to identify and correct errors in arguments and texts.
Effectively present and defend logical arguments and research findings.
Conduct independent research and apply logical methods to summarize and systematize research topics.
Understand and apply logical principles in the context of legal studies.
Analyze the historical development and significance of logic as a discipline.
Master the fundamental concepts and rules of formal logic.
Differentiate and apply inductive and deductive reasoning methods.
Construct and evaluate logical arguments and proofs.
